name: catalyst
description: Research-driven development workflow with Linear integration, PM tools, and infrastructure research agents — Codex plugin catalog.

plugins.name: catalyst-dev
plugins.description: Complete development workflow: research → plan → implement → validate → ship. Includes research agents, planning tools, handoff system, Linear integration, and PM commands.

plugins.name: catalyst-meta
plugins.description: Frontmatter validation, reference auditing, and directory reorganization tools for Catalyst plugin developers: keep skill and agent frontmatter consistent, find broken references, and safely reorganize directory structures.

plugins.name: catalyst-pm-ops
plugins.description: Linear backlog grooming — orphan, stale, and duplicate ticket detection

plugins.name: catalyst-legacy
plugins.description: Pre-phase-agent (wave-based) orchestration workflow preserved as a documented fallback: oneshot, orchestrate, god, setup-orchestrate. Superseded by catalyst-dev's execution-core/phase-agent pipeline. Requires catalyst-dev (shared backing scripts).

plugins.name: catalyst-foundry
plugins.description: Setup, maintenance, and compounding upkeep of the Catalyst framework and the thoughts/ knowledge base: framework diagnostics/repair (setup-catalyst), terminal launcher config (setup-warp), and research-doc curation (research-curate). Future home for the compound-engineering retro/learning loop.
